claims.text: Halfast was the son of Halfred, an uncle of Samwise Gamgee. He worked for Mr. Boffin in Overhill, and often went up in the Northfarthing to hunt.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "The Longfather-tree of Master Samwise"
